title: Fate/Extra Record gets January 28 release date alongside new trailer
summary: During the PlayStation State of Play on September 3, Japanese developer Type Moon Studio BB and publisher Aniplex announced that Fate/Extra record would launch on January 28. Alongside the announcement, they also unveiled a brand-new trailer for the game. Fate/Extra Record is a remake of Type-Moon’s dungeon crawler RPG Fate/Extra, which released for PlayStation Portable in 2010. The game was announced in 2020 and originally scheduled to launch in 2025. After a couple of delays, and Bandai Namco Entertainment pulling out of the distribution deal, Fate/Extra Record announced that it would get Aniplex as its new publisher. title: Konami announces mysterious new action-adventure game RHAPSODY IN SCARLET, set in 1920s New York
summary: Konami announced RHAPSODY IN SCARLET during the September 3 State of Play. Developed in Unreal Engine, this brand-new action-adventure game is set on the jazz-filled streets of 1920s New York, where protagonist Ellie Myers, a magus, embarks on a journey to confront a threat that could shake the world. The footage depicts a sprawling metropolis reminiscent of old-school America, where gigantic summoned beasts and monsters clash in flashy battles. It looks like players will wield beasts and magic in combat, chaining attacks together to build up combos.
